cli.usage:
nsonline {version}

Usage:
  nsonline setup    [--data-dir <dir>] [-no-browser]
                                         guided setup: consent, logins, watched account,
                                         Discord test, intervals, language
  nsonline config   [--data-dir <dir>]   change the settings (menu, saved on "s")
  nsonline login    [-v] [-auth-file F]   Nintendo login (PKCE), saves the session token
  nsonline me       [-v] [-auth-file F]   show your Nintendo Account profile
  nsonline friends  [-v] [-raw]          f token, Coral login, friend list (with nsaId)
  nsonline watch    -friend <nsaId|name> mirror a friend's NSO presence to Discord (poll loop)
  nsonline serve    [-addr 127.0.0.1:7878] watch + local API for the desktop app (app/)
  nsonline app      --data-dir <dir>     sidecar for the desktop app: random loopback port,
                                         prints NSONLINE_READY {...}, needs NSONLINE_API_TOKEN,
                                         exits when stdin closes; login/consent via the API
  nsonline rpc      [flags]              set a Discord Rich Presence by hand

setup and config use the desktop app's data folder by default (see README), and refuse to run while the app runs.

Global flag:
  --lang <en|fr>                         language of the messages (default: NSONLINE_LANG, else en;
                                         setup and config also use the language they saved)

Configuration (Discord app IDs, nxapi-znca-api client) is embedded at build
time by "make build" / "go generate ./backend/internal/secrets"; environment
variables and a .env in the current directory override it.

Run "nsonline <command> -h" for the flags of a command.
